name: openguild
description: Self-hosted Discord-style community: servers, text, voice, screen share, and a desktop app.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @steamfarm/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @steamfarm/api" "npm run dev -w @steamfarm/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @steamfarm/shared && npm run build -w @steamfarm/api && npm run build -w @steamfarm/web
